summary: I dry-ran the operator sequence for the second delivery in my own detached worktree at 5d6fb2dc. Nothing in identity, paths or leftovers of the first attempt would stop the next preflight: I found no blocking defect. Release, command generation, both wrappers (in a local fake $WORK with the old read-only checkout present) and the 24-stage fixture chain with the old manifest and failed receipt seeded in the output root all behave. The on-cluster plan write and the real run could not be executed locally because the output root /leonardo_work is hard-coded and cannot be created on the Mac; the cluster state itself is taken from the context. Two important gaps remain before handing over: the commit lacks the delivery document and validation receipt the addendum points to, and there is no local guard for the deploy commit before the one-shot submission. The rest is three minor documentation points and three notes. Housekeeping: my first scratch worktree and fake work area were removed by another process around 12:19; I recreated one for the last two checks and removed it. Five stand-in commits (26e5cc13, ab26dccc, 5c84413c, a977f289, f377718e) remain as unreachable objects, on no ref and never pushed. The author's worktree, the ledger and the cluster were not touched.

findings.title: Delivery document and validation receipt referenced by the addendum are not in the commit
findings.claim: At 5d6fb2dc the addendum sends the operator to a 'documento di consegna di Claude' for $TCN_CODE_SHA and source_sha256 (line 74) and to a validation receipt in results/infra/pose_temponet_execution_20261120/validation/ (line 82). Neither exists in the commit, and docs/claude_GPT_shared has no entry for the fix. Step 2 of the sequence cannot be completed from the committed state alone.
findings.evidence: `git ls-tree -r --name-only 5d6fb2dc -- results/infra/pose_temponet_execution_20261120 docs/reviews | grep -E 'pose_temponet_execution_20261120|claude_delivery|users_fix'` lists only plan.json, validate.py and real_input_headers/{check_headers.py,check_headers.txt,headers.json,read_headers.py}. `git show 5d6fb2dc:docs/claude_GPT_shared | grep -c -i -E 'storage_directories|users-fix|seconda consegna|pose_temponet_20261120|TCNH-preflight-20261120'` -> 0. At 12:20 the author's working tree held uncommitted drafts: untracked docs/reviews/claude_delivery_pose_temponet_users_fix_20261120.md, README.md, real_input_headers/meta_stats.json and read_meta_stats.py; modified check_headers.py, check_headers.txt and the 19/11 document. The draft names code 5d6fb2dc..., source_sha256 37985d28c75bf82a6a784106d414825b727b9ba78575b675dd2dac1d4ccfc8de and plan sha256 1e8e2b46...563e / 60,341 bytes; all three match what I computed. The modified check_headers.py reads meta_stats.json, which is untracked. README names delivery_pin.json and validation/, neither present yet. `P.source_manifest` on that working tree: 246 sources, digest 37985d28..., equal to the plan manifest.
findings.suggested_fix: Add one child commit (do not amend 5d6fb2dc) touching only docs/ and results/: the delivery document, the validation/ output of validate.py, delivery_pin.json, README, meta_stats.json together with the check_headers.py that reads it, and the registry entry. Afterwards re-run `python -m pose_temponet inspect --plan results/infra/pose_temponet_execution_20261120/plan.json` and confirm reader 37985d28.... --reviewed-code-sha can stay 5d6fb2dc: release-plan accepts any commit whose 246 sources match (verified with a metadata-only descendant).

findings.title: No local guard on the deploy commit before the single submission; the reviewed commit now comes from another agent's branch
findings.location: scripts/pose_temponet/__main__.py:208-236 (commands); scripts/pose_temponet/runner.py:212 and provenance.py:560-562 (checkout_identity); provenance.py:262-265 (review copy fallback); docs/pose_temponet_execution_20261120.md:75-78
findings.claim: `commands` accepts any 40-hex --checkout-sha. It does not check that the commit exists, descends from reader.code_sha, carries the plan's sources, or contains the released plan and the review copy. A deploy commit built by cherry-pick, rebase or squash of 5d6fb2dc, or one missing the review copy, is rejected only inside the job, after campaign_checkout has created pose_temponet_20261120 and the ID is 'sottomesso'. Both are then consumed and a third delivery with a source change is needed. The addendum states neither the ancestry requirement nor a pre-submission check. This is pre-existing behaviour, not introduced by the fix; the cross-branch handoff is what is new.
findings.evidence: (1) `commands ... --checkout-sha aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa` and `--checkout-sha f546c9e4...` (main) both print the submit line. (2) Y=a977f289 made with `git commit-tree ab26dccc^{tree} -p 31877ad8` has the same tree as a valid deploy commit but not 5d6fb2dc as ancestor. `commands` from a checkout of Y prints the line; `P.checkout_identity(plan)` gives `CalledProcessError ... ['git','merge-base','--is-ancestor','5d6fb2dc...','a977f289...'] returned non-zero exit status 1`. runner.py:212 is before the try block, so no failure receipt is written. (3) With the review commit unavailable and the copy absent from the checkout, `validate_plan(require_review=True)` gives `FileNotFoundError: ... DRYRUN_standin_review_tcn_users_fix_20261120.md`; with the copy tracked it is accepted. release-plan leaves the copy untracked when the review lives outside the branch history: `?? docs/reviews/DRYRUN_standin_review_names_source_only.md`. (4) Re-running the preflight wrapper with the checkout present: '...pose_temponet_20261120 esiste gia': un checkout di campagna non si modifica. Nessuna azione.' exit 2.
findings.suggested_fix: No source change. Add a local read-only check to the addendum between steps 3 and 4, with D = deploy SHA (= --checkout-sha = --plan-commit) and C = $TCN_CODE_SHA: `git merge-base --is-ancestor "$C" "$D"`; `git diff --quiet "$C" "$D" -- src scripts`; `[ "$(git show "$D:$PLAN" | shasum -a 256 | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$PLAN_SHA256" ]`; `git cat-file -e "$D:$TCN_REVIEW_PATH"`; working tree clean at D; `git ls-remote leonardo` of the deploy ref equals D. State that 5d6fb2dc must enter the operator branch by fast-forward or merge, never cherry-pick, rebase or squash. I ran the first five checks on a valid commit (all ok) and on three bad ones: squash fails the ancestry line, a source-changing descendant fails the diff line, the bare code commit fails the plan and review lines.

findings.title: The addendum does not say which artifact is passed as --review-commit/--review-path, and the recorded label says Claude
findings.claim: The addendum says the independent reread is GPT's but does not name the file and commit the operator must pass to release-plan. It also does not say the text must contain the full 40-hex code SHA or the 64-hex source_sha256. release_plan always writes status 'claude_review_converged', so plan and receipts will carry that label for an artifact that in this delivery is either GPT's reread or Claude's own delivery note.
findings.evidence: release-plan with a review file naming neither value: `ValueError: operational review must name the full reviewed code SHA or source SHA256`. Naming only 5d6fb2dc... in full, or only 37985d28..., is accepted. __main__.py:139 has the constant `"status": "claude_review_converged"`. The uncommitted delivery draft says at lines 22-24: 'Non è una review indipendente del diff: il diff è mio ... Questo documento nomina lo SHA completo e il source_sha256 perché release-plan li richiede'.
findings.suggested_fix: Name the artifact in the addendum: either GPT's reread file, which must quote 5d6fb2dc855bd3c12788bb6d3c3a66043c34f1ba or 37985d28c75bf82a6a784106d414825b727b9ba78575b675dd2dac1d4ccfc8de in full, or Claude's delivery document with GPT's verdict recorded in the registry. Add that the status string is a fixed schema label, not a statement of who reviewed.

findings.title: Inherited 19/11 instructions left ambiguous: CPU-model evidence and final accounting
findings.claim: The addendum keeps the 19/11 text 'parola per parola'. That includes (a) 'Prima del rilascio l'operatore confronta anche il modello CPU dei due nodi seriali', without saying whether the 10:58 evidence can be cited or new inventory jobs are needed; and (b) the closing 'sacct -X per tutte le 24 allocazioni', although with the first attempt there are 27 allocations and 0.0433 core-hours already spent against the unchanged caps.
findings.evidence: cpu_inventory_sacct via release_operator_read.txt: `64931087|COMPLETED|0:0|2|2|login08`, `64931101|COMPLETED|0:0|3|2|login13`; both nodes Xeon Platinum 8358 in operator_checks_release.json. The IDs TCNH-CPU-inventory-login08-20261120 and -login13-20261120 are already in ~/wearusfm_local/jobs. preflight_failure_result.json: total_actual_allocations 3, total_core_hours_including_inventory 0.043333. My arithmetic from the plan resources: the new chain requests 77.0 CPU-only core-hours inclusive of grace (0.5 + 4 + 64 + 8 + 0.5); the first attempt adds 0.043 actual, or 0.767 by requested caps (0.5 + 0.267), still under 80.
findings.suggested_fix: Two sentences in the addendum: the CPU-model evidence of jobs 64931087 and 64931101 stays valid and is cited in the new operator evidence, with no new inventory jobs; the final accounting covers 27 allocations and debits the first attempt's 0.0433 core-hours to the same caps.

findings.title: Local receipt copies for resource-plan must keep their logical names; undocumented, and the first attempt archived the receipt under another name
findings.claim: verified_receipt remaps every predecessor pin to <mirror dir>/<basename of the cluster path>. The local copies used by resource-plan and --completed-prerequisites must therefore sit in one folder as <ID>.json, including TCNH-preflight-20261120.json next to the two benchmark receipts. The documents only say 'legge le copie locali', and after the first attempt the operator saved the receipt as preflight_receipt.json. The failure is local and burns no job.
findings.evidence: Scratch test on the fixture chain, first three stages run through run_stage: mirror folder with the two benchmark receipts and the preflight receipt saved as preflight_receipt.json gives `R.measured_plan` -> `FileNotFoundError TCNH-preflight-20261120.json`. After copying it under its logical name: measured plan produced, receipt_pins ['TCNH-cpu-benchmark-20261120', 'TCNH-gpu-benchmark-20261120']. 1 passed in 2.95s.
findings.suggested_fix: One sentence in the addendum: collect every receipt as <ID>.json in a single folder, alongside any renamed archive copy.

findings.title: The authorization quote is not verifiable in the repository, and the reread assignment is the author's inference
findings.claim: The exchange «Autorizzi un nuovo preflight dopo la correzione e la mia rilettura?» / «Sì, autorizzo» appears only in the addendum. The decision for a new attempt (L3-9) is not recorded in docs/decisioni.md or the registry at this commit. The quoted question ties the preflight to 'la mia rilettura', and the diagnosis note has Claude as the rereader; the addendum then assigns the reread to GPT. Confirmation would be a registry or decisioni entry with the verbatim exchange and who asked, plus an explicit statement that GPT's reread satisfies the condition.
findings.evidence: `git grep -n -i -E 'Autorizzi un nuovo preflight|fai tu la correzione' 5d6fb2dc -- docs results` returns only lines 20-21 of the addendum; the same search on codex/pose-temponet-launcher-20261120, worktree-claude-training-engine and claude/temponet-db8-20261109 returns nothing. `git show 5d6fb2dc:docs/decisioni.md | grep -c -i -E '...|64931573'` -> 0. docs/reviews/claude_note_pose_temponet_preflight_users_20261120.md:84-85: 'Rileggo solo il diff, senza agenti' and 'Il nuovo tentativo richiede una decisione di Simone (L3-9)'. The second quote, «fai tu la correzione?», matches the request relayed to this workflow.
findings.suggested_fix: Before the launch, record the verbatim exchange and the L3-9 decision in the registry and in decisioni.md, and state who rereads and why.

findings.title: '20261120' already names first-attempt artifacts, and the 19/11 examples no longer run from the new sources
findings.claim: The old released plan, the operator's folder of the failed job and two diagnostic IDs (registered under campagna pose_temponet_20261119) already carry the date 20261120, so the suffix alone does not identify the second delivery. The 19/11 examples that inspect the 20261119 plan fail from the new sources. Every mix-up I tried is refused locally, so this is a readability risk only. The addendum does not name the output path for the new released plan.
findings.evidence: `inspect --plan results/infra/pose_temponet_execution_20261119/plan.json` -> `ValueError: reader sources changed`. `commands --plan results/infra/pose_temponet_execution_20261119/plan_released_20261120.json ...` -> `ValueError: reader sources changed`. `commands --plan <new released> --plan-repository-path results/infra/pose_temponet_execution_20261119/plan_released_20261120.json` -> `ValueError: plan has not been committed as declared`. `release-plan --plan results/infra/pose_temponet_execution_20261119/plan.json` with the new code -> `ValueError: reader sources changed`. release-plan onto an existing output path -> `FileExistsError`.
findings.suggested_fix: Name the new released plan and the operator folder in the addendum, for example results/infra/pose_temponet_execution_20261120/plan_released.json and .../launcher_preflight/. Commit the banner already drafted at the top of the 19/11 document.

findings.title: release-plan does not check that the operator evidence is new
findings.claim: The addendum asks for a new operator evidence with an updated observed_at, but release-plan only requires a timezone-aware timestamp. The evidence file of the first release, taken before the failed job, is accepted unchanged. The requirement is procedural only.
findings.evidence: release-plan on the new plan with --operator-checks results/infra/pose_temponet_execution_20261119/launcher_preflight_20261120/operator_checks_release.json is accepted; the output carries observed_at 2026-11-20T11:01:21+01:00. With those 11:01 numbers the quota gate has 5,805,740,032 bytes (5.407 GiB) of margin: free 44,460,445,696 against 12 GiB + pending 25,769,803,776.
findings.suggested_fix: Nothing in code. Keep the instruction, and have the operator write the new evidence to a new file in the 20261120 folder so the old one cannot be passed by habit.
